about: T17-T19 unit requirements and T26 browser assertions, not measurements made before the build. Requirements apply to all six screens; simulation instrumentation stays dark in both themes.

cases.test_owner: T19 decide-execute.spec.js with mocked transport only; never the anonymous judge path
cases.action: Navigate review, confirm approval, execute, then close receipt using keyboard only

visual_basis: System brief §12 colour tokens are the starting point, not proof of contrast. If a token pair fails its rendered contrast check, adjust that pair while retaining the brief's reading-surface / dark-instrument split; record the result in T26 evidence. No measured contrast ratio is claimed here.
